title: [Subcontracting] Bug 641607: Fix misleading error message when disabling Legacy Subcontracting with open WIP purchase orders
summary: Fixed the error message when disabling Legacy Subcontracting to correctly state that only purchase orders with WIP Items block the operation, not all subcontracting purchase orders.
key_points: Error message now accurately reflects the actual filter condition that checks only WIP Items
Wording aligned with the sibling transfer order error message for consistency
Added test scenario to verify the corrected error message wording
No changes to the underlying business logic or filtering condition
Ensures users see accurate messaging about what prevents disabling Legacy Subcontracting
